svg.title: Astrographic type 1: actual lettering before and after the selection correction
svg.desc: Before, ABC-123 uses the Classic type 4 research unit. Current output uses the type 1 research specimens and digit chart, with constructed production B and C. All plate-lettering path data is copied unchanged from the committed comparison artifacts; placement is uniformly scaled. These remain candidate reconstructions.

g.text: B and C retain their constructed production outlines.
